'''Teprimal''' was an [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] instructor about the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B Frigate]] ''[[Tedevium]]''. He worked with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Atton Repness]], and was a conspirator in the colonel's black-market scheme. [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil]] recorded a conversation between Repness and Teprimal about the theft and subsequent sale of an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] starfighter. Notsil exposed Teprimal along with Repness when she secretly passed the information along to [[Director of New Republic Intelligence]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].
